project.name: vibeDesk
project.description: A web-based CMS and backoffice for managing articles, media, and content.

features.name: Categories
features.description: Staff create, rename and remove the categories that group articles.

features.name: Articles
features.description: Staff write articles with a title, slug, body and category, save them as draft, publish and archive them.

features.name: Pages
features.description: Staff edit static pages such as About and Contact, each with a title, slug and body.

parkingLot: Media library (file uploads need a storage library that is not in the Contract Kit library yet)

customRules.text: Article and page slugs are unique and created with slugify from helpers/.
